english.title: Polling station attendant communicate voter identity

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Political Parties Elections and Referendums Act 2000

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a returning officer attending,]_
(B)_[a presiding officer attending,]_
(C)_[a clerk attending,]_
(D)_[a candidate attending,]_
(E)_[an election agent attending,]_
(F)_[a polling agent attending,]_
(G)_[a representative of the Commission attending, by virtue of section 6A of the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000,]_
(H)_[a representative of the Commission attending, by virtue of section 6B of the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000,]_
(I)_[an accredited observer attending, by virtue of section 6C of the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000,]_
(J)_[a nominated person attending, by virtue of section 6D of the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000,]_

at a polling station, namely **(..SPECIFY POLLING STATION..), unlawfully communicated to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), before the poll was closed, information as to the

(K)_[name of an elector who had or had not applied for a ballot paper]_
(L)_[name of an elector who had or had not voted at a polling station]_
(M)_[name of a proxy for an elector who had or had not applied for a ballot paper]_
(N)_[name of a proxy for an elector who had or had not voted at a polling station]_
(O)_[number on the register of electors of an elector who had or had not applied for a ballot paper]_
(P)_[number on the register of electors of an elector who had or had not voted at a polling station]_
(Q)_[number on the register of electors of a proxy for an elector who had or had not applied for a ballot paper]_
(R)_[number on the register of electors of a proxy for an elector who had or had not voted at a polling station]_
(S)_[official mark]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 66(1) and (6) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a returning officer, presiding officer or clerk attending at a polling station, or
candidate or election agent or polling agent so attending or
person so attending by virtue of any of sections 6A to 6D of the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000
other than for a purpose authorised by law
communicated to a person before the poll was closed, information as to
the name of any elector or proxy for an elector who has or has not applied for a ballot paper or voted at a polling station or
the number on the register of electors of any elector who, or whose proxy, has or has not applied for a ballot paper or voted at a polling station or
the official mark.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
